# 關於運行 KC Pathfinder 接駁車的提示 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold]（kW）為 [color=#a4885c]27 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - 駕駛艙內有兩個按鈕：其中一個帶有黃黑相間邊框的按鈕用來控制窗戶百葉窗，可切換太空梭內所有百葉窗的開闔狀態，唯獨宿舍內的百葉窗以及停靠站旁外部氣閘上方的百葉窗除外。 那個帶有灰色邊框的按鈕用來控制推進器。
- For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - For the basics of [bold]cargo hauling[/bold], refer to [textlink="Cargo Hauling" link="CargoHauling"]. - For the basics of [bold]expedition diving[/bold], refer to [textlink="Expeditions" link="Expeditions"]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
